places.quote: We have removed, from Buckingham Street, to a pleasant little cottage very near the one I looked at
places.note: David and his aunt have moved away from it.

places.quote: My aunt, however (who has sold the house at Dover, to good advantage)
places.note: The aunt's former house is here.

places.quote: Why does Traddles look so important when he calls upon me this afternoon in the Commons
places.note: Refers to Doctors' Commons, not the House of Commons.

places.quote: I should think the Inner Temple must have made a profit by it.
I have brought Agnes from the Canterbury coach, and her cheerful and beautiful face is among us for the second time.
places.note: Refers to the coach from Canterbury, the place Agnes travels from.

places.quote: Miss Clarissa and my aunt roam all over London, to find out articles of furniture
